title: Laksha Rypen 2026
summary: Laksha Rypen 2026, organised by Rotary Club of Palghar on 31st October and 1st November, aims to empower 280 tribal students (Standards 8–10) through a two-day residential enrichment programme.
description:
Laksha Rypen 2026, organised by Rotary Club of Palghar on 31st October and 1st November, aims to empower 280 tribal students (Standards 8–10) through a two-day residential enrichment programme.

The initiative covers career guidance, motivation, health, hygiene, environment, digital literacy, values and awareness of government schemes, with a project cost of ₹3 lakh.
